parsed.internal_thinking: Ziv is trying to put a target on my back because I'm at 4 points. The roll of 9 was actually amazing for me—I now have 5 חיטה and 4 עץ. With my 3:1 port at node 9, I can actually trade for the טיט and כבשה I need to build my final settlement at node 23 and win. I need to downplay my position so I don't get robbed before my turn. I'll point out that Ziv and Shon also got resources from that roll.
parsed.note_to_self: I have the win in hand! On my turn, I can use my 3:1 port: trade 3 עץ for 1 טיט and 3 חיטה for 1 כבשה. Then I build a settlement at node 23. I must stay quiet and hope no one rolls a 7 or plays a Knight on me.
parsed.say_outloud: הנה, קיבלת חיטה, אולי עכשיו תשתחרר קצת מהתקיעות. אל תדאג לי, הדרך לניצחון עוד ארוכה כשאין לי טיט בכלל.
